- RollingUpdate strategy with zero downtime

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: app-deployment
  namespace: prod-apps
  labels:
    app: microservice-app
    version: v1.0
spec:
  replicas: 4
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 25%
      maxUnavailable: 0
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: microservice-app
  template:
    metadata:
      annotations:
        sidecar.istio.io/inject: "true"
        prometheus.io/scrape: "true"
        prometheus.io/port: "8080"
        prometheus.io/path: "/metrics"
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: app-container
          image: company-private-registry.io/prod-images/app:v1.0
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8080
            - name: metrics
              containerPort: 8080
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 1Gi
            requests:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 512Mi
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health/liveness
              port: 8080
            initialDelaySeconds: 30
            periodSeconds: 10
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health/readiness
              port: 8080
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 5
          env:
            - name: ENVIRONMENT
              value: "production"
      imagePullSecrets:
        - name: regcred-prod
      volumes:
        - name: persistent-storage
          emptyDir: {}
      # Optional PVC (if stateful logic required)
      # volumeClaimTemplates:

      #     spec:
      #       accessModes: ["ReadWriteOnce"]
      #       storageClassName: "ssd-standard"
      #       resources:
      #         requests:
      #           storage: 10Gi
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: egress-restrictions-app
  namespace: prod-apps
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: microservice-app
  policyTypes:
    - Egress
  egress:
    - to:
        - ipBlock:
            cidr: 10.200.0.0/16  # Assuming internal auth-service subnet
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 443
    - to:
        - dnsName: monitoring.company.internal
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 443
    - to:
        - dnsName: api.internal.auth-service
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 443
    # Block all other egress traffic by default
```

            requests:

              memory: 512Mi
